description: The media asset has been calibrated with a field‑of‑view setting that yields a 110‑degree diagonal coverage. Horizontally, the view spans 100 degrees, while the vertical span is set to 80 degrees, providing a balanced perspective for the intended scene. These parameters should be used for any rendering or playback configuration that relies on precise FOV specifications.
